subject: hep-th
title_original: The Large Vector Multiplet and Gauging $(2,2)$ $σ$-models
authors: Dmitri Bykov, Ulf Lindström, Martin Roček
abstract: The Large Vector Multiple (LVM) is the relevant gauge multiplet for gauging isometries acting on both the chiral and the twisted chiral fields in a $(2, 2)$ sigma model. Here we show that a recently proposed new gauge multiplet is a constrained or partially dualized version of the LVM. Gauging using this multiplet results in a $(2, 2)$ $βγ$ system interacting with a sigma model.
title_relatable: A simpler way to gauge quantum field theories in two dimensions
hook: Physicists found that a recently proposed gauge multiplet is just a constrained version of an older one—and it naturally produces a hybrid system combining two classic models.
summary: In 2D quantum field theories with specific symmetries, you need the right multiplet to gauge isometries. This work shows a newly proposed multiplet is actually a constrained variant of the Large Vector Multiplet, and using it produces a system where a βγ system couples to a sigma model—connecting what looked like separate structures.
